0022600002.text: The New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers as both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance to win. The teams split their 2025-26 regular season series 2-2, and the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision for New York, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, and has Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring), and VJ Edgecombe (rest) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
